methodology: Cross-repository issue-only predictions and deterministic plan receipts were frozen from ArkType pre-fix parents before any fixing diff or post-fix source was opened.

phases.instruction: Inspect the preserved repository-adaptive shortlist first.
phases.stop_condition: Stop when one candidate explains and reproduces the behavior; otherwise expand within the anchored files.

phases.instruction: Inspect the strongest remaining declarations from the selected semantic families.
phases.stop_condition: Stop by inspection ten when a family owns the behavior; use the final fallback only while ownership remains unresolved.

phases.instruction: Inspect one final ranked family member without widening to another file.
phases.stop_condition: After this bounded fallback, report uncertainty instead of generating more owner guesses.
